title: Spare Key
mood: giddy, out of breath, happily in love
subject: getting a spare key cut for your partner at the key kiosk under the stairs at Waterloo station
caption: UK pop drum and bass in the current festival style. A clean, tightly quantized two-step drum and bass beat with a kick on one and on the and of three, a sharp layered snare on two and four, and ghost-note hi-hats; a rolling sub bass in the verses that turns into a growling detuned Reese bass for the drop; euphoric piano stabs on the off-beats; wide supersaw chords building through a riser and a white-noise sweep into the drop. Clean and wide, the sub and snare forward, the piano bright and close. Female voice, a clear pop soprano, close and conversational in the verses, open and full in the chorus. 174 BPM, E minor. Giddy, out of breath, happily in love. No chopped Amen breaks, no ragga voice, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dubstep wobble, no sampled voice hooks.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano stabs and rolling sub, short]

[Verse 1]
Key kiosk under the stairs at Waterloo
Man with a grinder and a radio on
I hand him mine and he says just the one?
I say just the one, and I go red

[Pre-Chorus]
Sparks off the wheel and my heart's going
Eight pound fifty, I tap my card twice

[Chorus]
It's a spare key, it's a spare key
Brass and still warm in my hand
Second on the left when you get to the top
You don't have to knock again

[Drop - growling Reese bass and full drums, no vocals]

[Verse 2]
I put it on a ring with a plastic lemon
So you'll find it at the bottom of your bag
Practised what to say on the Northern line
Then I just said here, and you just said oh

[Pre-Chorus]
You tried it in the door that night
Jiggle it left, it sticks a bit

[Chorus]
It's a spare key, it's a spare key
Brass and still warm in your hand
Second on the left when you get to the top
You don't ever have to knock again

[Drop - growling Reese bass and full drums, no vocals]

[Outro - piano alone after the drop, then the sub cuts out]
Came home Thursday and the lights were on
You'd let yourself in
